ffmpeg.winget: Install it with winget, in a terminal:
ffmpeg.restart: Quit and reopen LocalCut, so the engine sees the new PATH.
ffmpeg.restartOn: Restart the engine on {host}, so it sees the new PATH.
ffmpeg.bin: Or put ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe from any FFmpeg build in {bin}. LocalCut uses them from the next job, with no restart.
ffmpeg.apt: Install it from your package manager. On Ubuntu or Debian:
ffmpeg.brew: Install the full build with Homebrew. The plain ffmpeg formula can't draw captions or titles.
ffmpeg.link: Link it into LocalCut's own folder, where it comes first:
ffmpeg.site: Install FFmpeg from its site, in a build with libass so captions and titles render.
ffmpeg.check: Check again. LocalCut also tests that captions and titles render.
